title: Fluorescence-resonance-energy-transfer-based assay to estimate modulation of TDP1 activity through arginine methylation
protocol: Reconstitute human Tyrosyl DNA Phosphodiesterase (TDP1) plasmid in calcium chloride to make chemically competent BL21 DE3 cells.
Transform the competent cells with the HisTDP1WT plasmid containing an ampicillin resistance gene and a codon-optimized TDP1 synthetic gene.
Plate the transformed cells onto agar plates supplemented with 100 μg/mL ampicillin.
Incubate the plates overnight at 37°C for 12–18 hours.
Pick a single colony from the plate to inoculate 50 mL of Luria Bertani broth containing 100 μg/mL ampicillin in an Erlenmeyer flask.
Inoculate a secondary culture by transferring cells from the primary culture into 500 mL of LB broth prepared in a 1000 mL Erlenmeyer flask, supplemented with 100 μg/mL ampicillin.
Incubate the secondary culture overnight at 37°C on a shaker incubator set to 250 rpm.
Induce protein expression with 0.75 mM IPTG when the culture reaches an absorbance of 0.4-0.6 at 600 nm.
Centrifuge cells at 3000 g for 15 min at 4°C after 4 hours of induction at 37°C.
Resuspend cell pellet in 20 mL TDP1 breaking buffer with vortexing every 30 minutes on ice for 4 hours.
Sonicate the resuspended sample at 30% amplitude for 30 seconds, followed by a 2-minute pause on ice, repeating this cycle for 30 minutes total.
Centrifuge the sonicated sample at 15,000 × g for 30 min at 4°C to clear debris.
Filter the supernatant through a 0.22 μm syringe filter.
Load filtered supernatant onto a 5 mL packed Whatman Cellulose Phosphate P11 column.
Wash the P11 column with 10 mL phosphocellulose wash buffer.
Elute the sample from the column using 10 mL phosphocellulose elution buffer.
Desalt the eluate using a PD-10 column equilibrated with dialysis buffer without KCl.
Equilibrate Ni2+-NTA agarose bead silica column with equilibration/binding buffer twice.
Load desalted eluate onto the column and collect flow through on a coaster.
Wash column with 8 column volumes of TDP1 Ni2+-NTA wash buffer.
Pass 6 column volumes of Ni2+-NTA elution buffer through the column.
Collect elute as 1 mL fractions and store at -80°C.
Pool elution fraction and dialyze using a dialysis membrane overnight in storage/elution buffer without imidazole.
Concentrate TDP1 protein by loading dialyzed eluate in a 50 kDa cut concentrator.
Centrifuge for 20 min at 800 × g.
Pool fractions containing the protein of interest.
Concentrate the pooled fractions.
Freeze aliquots in liquid nitrogen for storage at −80°C.
Measure protein concentration using Bradford assay with BSA standard.
Run on an SDS-PAGE to check purity.
Transfect pCMV-Tag2B-FLAG-PRMT5 into HEK293 cells.
Immunoprecipitate PRMT5 using anti-FLAG antibody (anti-mouse antibody M2 F3165).
Add 8 μL of FLAG-PRMT5 IP beads with 2 μg of recombinant TDP1 protein in methylation buffer.
Incubate the microcentrifuge tube at 30°C for 2 h.
Stop the reaction by adding 2×SDS loading buffer and boiling samples for 5 min.
Check the methylation signal on TDP1 by running the reaction mixture on a SDS PAGE and probing with SDMA antibody.
Seed HEK293 cells in two T-25 flasks to achieve 70% confluency the next day (2*10^6 cells).
Transfect HEK293 cells with pCMV-Tag2B-FLAG-TDP1 using Lipofectamine 2000 following manufacturer’s protocol.
Culture HEK293 cells in DMEM supplemented with 10% fetal bovine serum and 1% penicillin/streptomycin.
Avoid using antibiotics during transfection.
Centrifuge cells at 1,500 × g for 6 minutes at 4°C, 48 hours post-transfection.
Resuspend and wash the total pellet with ice-cold PBS followed by centrifugation; repeat the PBS wash.
Resuspend the pellet in 200 μL of ice-cold 1× IP lysis buffer (50 mM Tris–HCl (pH 8), 300 mM NaCl, 0.4% NP-40, 5 mM DTT and 1× protease inhibitor cocktail) for 1 hour, vortexing every 15 minutes.
Centrifuge the cells at 15,000 × g for 10 minutes at 4°C after incubation.
Collect 10% supernatant (lysate) in a separate microcentrifuge tube for input sample.
Collect the remaining supernatant (lysate) and add 100 μL IP dilution buffer (50 mM Tris–HCl (pH 8), 0.4% NP-40, 5 mM DTT and 1× protease inhibitor cocktail).
Incubate diluted lysate with 100 μL Protein A/G beads (50% slurry) at 4°C for 30–60 minutes for preclearing the cell lysate.
Centrifuge the mixture at 15,000 × g for 1 minute at 4°C and collect supernatant in a new IP vial.
Incubate diluted lysate with 10 μL (10 μg/mL) anti-FLAG antibody (anti-mouse antibody M2 F3165) in an end-over-end rotator at 4°C for 1 hour.
Add 100 μL Protein A/G beads to the FLAG antibody mixed lysate and incubate overnight at 4°C in a rotator.
Centrifuge the mixture at 15,000 × g for 1 minute at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the beads in 1 mL IP wash buffer followed by centrifugation at 15,000 × g for 1 min at 4°C.
Repeat the IP wash twice.
Store the beads in −80°C degree after discarding the supernatant.
Dissolve synthesized oligo HEI-50 in an oligo dissolving buffer to a final concentration of 50 μM.
Heat the solution at 80°C for 10 minutes.
Rapidly cool on ice to promote hairpin formation.
Maintain the dsDNA (HEI-50) substrate at 4°C before use.
Minimize exposure to light during handling and storage.
Keep TDP1 recombinant protein and TDP1 immune complexes on ice.
Keep TDP1 substrates (HEI-40/HEI-50) on ice.
Keep cleavage assay buffer on ice.
Make a master mix to minimize error.
Mix samples in a microcentrifuge tube or directly in the well of a 96-well plate.
Add enzyme (TDP1) at the end just before placing the plate inside the reader.
Use a new tip for each well when loading TDP1 enzyme to avoid cross contamination.
Add 100 μL of cleavage assay buffer to a well as a blank buffer control.
Add reaction mixture to a well as a negative control.
Measure fluorescence intensity of all samples using settings described in materials and equipment.
Save data after measurement is completed.
Take the plate out of the plate reader when done.
Ensure Shake and Read steps are indented during Kinetic steps in SpectraMax M5 multimode microplate reader acquisition setting.
